changelog: Resource was never moved to a stable 1.0.0 now it is.
Entire rebuild and refactor throughout and general code improvements.
Removed the minigame requirement to open, the environment is enough of a minigame.
Replaced NUI display with a drawn one, since it is being updated every frame anyway.
No longer requires any external dependencies, plug and play (other than adding items).
Diving tanks can now be refilled by placing a compressor.
Rebreathers are now destroyed when empty correctly and restores old clothing when expires.
